policies.title: Portuguese ordinary passports: Bosnia and Herzegovina visa-free short visit
policies.summary: Bosnia and Herzegovina's Foreign Ministry expressly exempts Portuguese citizens from its visa requirement for a short visit.
conditions: Portuguese citizens are visa-exempt for entry, exit or transit for up to 90 days in six months.
This excludes work, residence, carrier rules and final admission.
